title: flare/activity/v1
description: The responses and comment events on the named flares, oldest first, and the cursor of the next call.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

next.description: The next steps, in the order the text prints them. It is absent when there are none.

commands.description: The commands that carry out the step, in order.

call.description: A command line of this tool.

run.description: A command line of another program.

text.description: The sentence or phrase that the text prints for the step.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

also.description: The other flares a response responds to that the caller can open.

at.description: When it happened, in RFC 3339 UTC.

body.description: The comment's or reply's text after the event; absent for a response or a deletion.

by.description: The person who responded, wrote, edited or deleted.

comment.description: The comment or reply the event is about, for a comment event.

parent.description: The comment a reply answers, or an edited or deleted reply is on.

share.description: The responding share's id, for a response.

title.description: The responding share's title, for a response.

version.description: The version of the flare it responds to, for a response.

more.description: Whether newer responses wait past this page.

saved_as.description: The name this call saved the cursor under, when it ran with `--since-last`.
